## Claim & Evidence

**Claim:** 灵猫香 (língmāoxiāng) is a Chinese incense ingredient (animal-derived, not botanical) — civet, the glandular secretion of civets (Civettictis civetta / Viverricula indica) — with an aroma profile of animalic, musky, sweet, warm. Most 'civet' today is synthetic.
